messages:
sara: Customer opened with an invoice spike. They say the SDK estimator reports ~120 tokens but the invoice (and our metering header) shows ~420. They were streaming a completion with a function call and an external tool that returns a short JSON. Any quick ideas? :thinking_face:

matt: Are they using the JS SDK or raw API? Any chance of double-encoding or duplicate sends?

sara: JS SDK v0.9.2. Repro steps from customer: they stream with function_call: 'auto' + use the prefill param to inject a short 'context_summary' before the prompt. They shared a curl repro but I haven't had time to run it.

sara: curl snippet they provided:```bash
curl -s -D - \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \
  -d '{"model":"open-ish-7b","stream":true,"prefill":"ctx: user recent actions","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize X"}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```

matt: Thanks. Two quick suspects: 1) server-side prefill is accounted as tokens on the invoice but the local estimator only counts the visible 'messages' array, and 2) when streaming + function_call we sometimes pre-serialize the tool call args into a hidden preamble which can add ~200 tokens in some runtimes.

sara: I checked the invoice metadata (billing-bot pasted) and it shows token breakdown: "prompt: 130, completion: 40, server_prefill: 250 (hidden)" — that matches the delta. But customer insists their SDK estimator includes prefill in estimates. Confusing.

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-02-28 for cust_42: total_tokens=420; breakdown metadata tags: ["prompt_visible","completion","server_prefill_v2","kv_cache_prefill"].

kumar: @sara can you repro locally with the same model + SDK and set REDWOOD_DEBUG_METERING=1 so the SDK prints its estimate and the final response header? Also try raw curl to isolate SDK differences.

sara: Will do. Quick note: customer reported they reused the same socket and resumed a stream after a network hiccup. Could that cause duplicate prefill accounting?

matt: Possibly — our resume logic can re-send prefill frames in some streaming codepaths if the client reconnects without ack. That would show up as extra tokens server-side but not in the client's single-run estimator. Good lead.

sara: Reproduced locally with streaming resume: SDK estimator prints 125 tokens, response header `x-redwood-tokens: 420` and response header metadata `X-Redwood-Metering-Details: server_prefill=250; resume_resend=45; visible=125`. Repro steps: 1) open stream, receive partial completion, 2) cut TCP, 3) reconnect and let SDK resume — server resends prefill frames on resume.

kumar: OK that's actionable. Two fixes: a) server should deduplicate prefill on resume if the client provides a resume token, b) SDK should include a warning when using resume that server may account additional tokens.

ops-bot: Created ticket RINF-7345 and assigned to eng-runtime (kumar). Priority: P2. Logs attached: `resume-repro-2951234567.log`

sara: I'll reply to the customer with repro explanation and ask whether they can avoid resume for now; also offer a temporary invoice credit while we investigate? Thoughts on credits?

matt: Approve small goodwill credit for the affected invoice and escalate for a patch. Add a note to docs about "stream resume metering caveat".

kumar: I'll start a small hotfix to check resume tokens and dedupe server-prefill frames. Will post PR and rollout plan.

sara: Thanks everyone — sending an update to the customer now. :white_check_mark:
